summary: Backend: 10/10 pytest passing against public URL. All required endpoints (/status, /config GET+PUT persistence, /signals with side+status filter, /signals/{id} + 404, /candles/BTC-USDT?timeframe=1h with RSI array, POST /scan non-blocking, /history/stats, /pairs sorted by volume) work correctly. Frontend: all 4 screens (Signals list, Detail with SVG candlestick + RSI subchart + metrics grid + technical context, History with stats row + rows, Settings with all form sections + Save) render properly on mobile viewport (390x844). Tab navigation via bottom tab bar works; Long/Short filter and timeframe chips render. 15 active signals generated by backend on first scan; a signal card tap navigates to /detail/{id} with full chart. No red screens, no runtime errors, no API failures.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' - children of an <svg> element (likely candles/wicks/FVG lines) rendered without stable keys. Cosmetic warning only; chart renders correctly.
React Native Web deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Comes from a dependency (likely react-native-svg/expo-router). Not blocking.

action_items: Add unique key prop to mapped children in PriceChart SVG (detail screen) to silence React key warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: MongoDB _id excluded via projection in all read endpoints — good.
server.py: PUT /config replaces the full singleton document via $set with model_dump(); acceptable since Pydantic defaults enforce required fields.
server.py: rsi_wilder rsis array length matches closes length only when len(closes) >= period+1; /candles response guarantees rsi length == candles length in that case (verified in tests).
api.ts uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — matches frontend/.env; correct.
Background scheduler starts with 5s warm-up + repeats every scan_interval_minutes (min 60s) — matches spec.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend auto-scan produced 15 live signals from KuCoin public API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) is the frontend env key. Public URL: https://divergence-trader-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Tab bar labels are 'Signals'/'History'/'Settings' — reliable text selectors. Signal cards are tappable and route to /detail/{id}. First scan runs 5s after backend startup; if 0 signals, POST /api/scan then wait ~30s.
